workflow_steps.title: Count hospitals by census tract
workflow_steps.purpose: Spatially count hospital point features within the Centre County census tract polygons.
workflow_steps.instructions: Count input_1 hospital points within input_2 census tract polygons. Preserve the polygon features and add a hospital-count attribute. Do not assume an output field name; runtime QC must ground or assign the count field for downstream mapping.

workflow_steps.title: Map hospital counts by census tract
workflow_steps.purpose: Generate the requested choropleth map from the counted census tract layer.
workflow_steps.instructions: Create an interactive HTML choropleth using counted_tracts. Runtime QC must identify the hospital-count attribute produced by the upstream aggregation and populate the mapping field parameter; do not guess a field name.
